{{Top|leg}}
'''Life support computers''' were medical [[Computer/Legends|computers]] that monitored a patient's life signs. A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] associate of [[Gyaxx]] ended up hooked up to life support computers in the medical wing at [[Avenel Rest Station]] after his body began to fail after he stopped using [[myostim unit]]s to maintain his physique.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
